checkpoints.reason: i18n decoupling: EN/FI/SV correctness is not provable by the gates (English-only snapshots, no multi-locale/visual suite). Needs browser + multi-locale review.
navigation decoupling: routing/active-link behavior is not exercised by unit tests or a11y snapshots. Needs browser review.
publishing to a registry is outward-facing and irreversible.

reactPublicSurface.note: Pre-publish package-boundary ratchet. @digitaltableteur/react is a curated design-system package surface: primitives, DS display/layout/form/navigation/feedback components, host adapters/providers, and accessibility/runtime hooks. It intentionally does not export Digitaltableteur app/product/site composition such as chat, site chrome, portfolio/blog cards, social/profile sharing, maps, booking/CV utilities, or route-specific layouts, even when those contracts are stable in the internal catalog. Normal mode fails if required curated contracts are missing, any forbidden app/product export appears, any unexpected unmapped uppercase export appears, or any alpha contract enters the surface. Strict publish-ready mode also requires zero alpha contract exports.

approval.note: Approved publishing @digitaltableteur/react to the private npm registry through the GitHub Actions OIDC Trusted Publisher workflow after strict local readiness gates pass.

5.1.note: @digitaltableteur/tokens@0.1.0, @digitaltableteur/tokens-css@0.1.0, and @digitaltableteur/react@0.1.1 are published as private/restricted npm packages. check:registry-token-install verifies token package registry access/installability, check:package-registry-status verifies current package registry state, and check:react-registry-install verifies the published React package from npm. Remaining roadmap work: publish the next React patch through the committed GitHub Actions OIDC Trusted Publisher path rather than manual npm publish.

5.2.note: Consumer setup docs and second-consumer path documented in docs/design-system/npm-consumer-setup.md, including install order, CSS imports, host adapters, i18n bridge, and package/site guard commands.

5.3.note: The site dogfoods the registry @digitaltableteur/react package import path and package stylesheet. The root install now also consumes @digitaltableteur/tokens and @digitaltableteur/tokens-css from npm while runtime CSS continues to load variables.css for exact visual continuity.

5.4.note: Added check:npm-consumer-install. It packs @digitaltableteur/tokens, @digitaltableteur/tokens-css, and @digitaltableteur/react, installs those tarballs into a clean temporary consumer, resolves token JS/JSON/CSS/theme exports plus React package CSS, imports public adapters/chrome patterns, SSR-renders an installed Button, compiles a strict TypeScript consumer against the emitted declarations, and writes .omx/state/design-system/npm-consumer-install/latest.json.

5.5.note: Added check:registry-token-install. It installs @digitaltableteur/tokens@0.1.0 and @digitaltableteur/tokens-css@0.1.0 from the private npm registry into a clean temporary consumer, verifies token JS/JSON/Tailwind/CSS/theme exports from node_modules, and writes .omx/state/design-system/registry-token-install/latest.json.

5.6.note: check:react-publish-preflight aggregates lint, typecheck, full Vitest, Storybook static build, Next production build, roadmap ratchets, package release metadata, Trusted Publisher readiness, registry package resolution, private token registry install, current React registry install, local tarball consumer install, package tarball contents guard, package publish dry-run guard, React public surface guard, React public API guard, package dogfood browser checks, the i18n/navigation visual review packet, and the consolidated React publish review packet. Strict check:react-publish-ready keeps the next React patch publish-only path honest by requiring the prepared next React version to be unpublished before OIDC publish.

5.7.note: Added check:react-public-surface. The @digitaltableteur/react public contract surface now exports the curated reusable design-system contract set, excludes alpha contracts, and is ratcheted at zero alpha. App/product/site composition remains forbidden even when it exists in the internal catalog. Strict --require-publishable mode also requires zero alpha contract exports.

5.8.note: Added check:react-public-api and packages/react/public-api.manifest.json. The guard freezes the curated @digitaltableteur/react runtime export list (105 exports after package-boundary narrowing) and package subpath exports, writes .omx/state/design-system/react-public-api/latest.json, and requires --update for intentional public API changes. check:react-package and check:react-publish-preflight now run it.

5.9.note: Added package CHANGELOG coverage for all npm packages plus check:package-release-notes. The guard verifies @digitaltableteur/tokens, @digitaltableteur/tokens-css, and @digitaltableteur/react use semver, restricted npm publish metadata, GitHub repository metadata for npm Trusted Publisher matching, dist package files, required exports, version-matched changelog entries, and current npm-served public API/consumer docs. check:react-publish-preflight now runs it before registry/package install checks.

5.10.note: Added check:react-publish-review. It validates the latest i18n/navigation review report and screenshots, package-consumed app dogfood report, React public API report, public-surface maturity report, package release metadata, package tarball contents, package publish dry-runs, Trusted Publisher readiness, local tarball consumer install evidence, published-token registry install evidence, and React registry install smoke state, then writes .omx/state/design-system/react-publish-review/latest.{md,json,html}; the HTML contact sheet lays out EN/FI/SV screenshots, navigation checks, browser dogfood checks, and package publish readiness evidence for human review without clearing 1.5, 1.6, or 5.1 approvals.

5.11.note: Added check:package-tarballs. It runs npm pack --dry-run --json for @digitaltableteur/tokens, @digitaltableteur/tokens-css, and @digitaltableteur/react, verifies required files and size/file-count ceilings, writes .omx/state/design-system/package-tarball-contents/latest.json, and fails on source/config/test/story/env/media leakage outside the intended dist plus package metadata payload.

5.12.note: Replaced the broad stable-contract export assumption with a curated package boundary. @digitaltableteur/react exports primitives, DS display/layout/form/navigation/feedback components, host adapters/providers, and accessibility/runtime hooks, while forbidding app/product/site composition such as chat, site chrome, portfolio/blog cards, social/profile sharing, maps, booking/CV utilities, and route-specific layouts. check:react-public-surface now fails if required curated contracts are missing, app/product exports appear, unexpected uppercase exports appear, or alpha contracts enter the package surface.

5.13.note: Added Trusted Publisher readiness for npm OIDC publishing. Package manifests now carry repository.url git+https://github.com/PetriLahdelma/digitaltableteur.git plus workspace repository.directory values, .github/workflows/ds-publish.yml is a manual-only GitHub Actions publish transport with id-token: write and npm@latest on Node 24, check:trusted-publisher verifies the workflow/package metadata, writes .omx/state/design-system/trusted-publisher/handoff.md with the exact npm form values, official npm trust CLI list/dry-run/configure commands, npm trust 403 troubleshooting, and a repository commit-scope table, and writes publish-pathspec.txt plus excluded-dirty-paths.txt so the eventual publish transport commit can be staged from a precise path list without sweeping in unrelated local work. The commit scope includes package manifests, publish guards, token build scripts, token catalog/DTCG inputs, variables.css, React package sources, public navigation pattern sources, and host adapter utilities, because GitHub Actions rebuilds token and React packages from repository source. check:react-publish-clearance lets the publish transport confirm recorded React approvals without replacing local-machine CI quality gates. The clearance handoff now records local review-evidence summaries and warnings for the i18n/navigation matrix, package dogfood report, React review packet, Trusted Publisher handoff, and preflight report.

5.14.note: Added check:package-publish-dry-run. It runs npm publish --dry-run --access restricted --json from each package directory for @digitaltableteur/tokens, @digitaltableteur/tokens-css, and @digitaltableteur/react, verifies publish id, integrity, shasum, and required package files, writes .omx/state/design-system/package-publish-dry-run/latest.json, and is wired into the manual GitHub Actions OIDC workflow before any dry-run or real publish.

5.15.note: check:package-registry-status verifies the current external npm state: @digitaltableteur/tokens, @digitaltableteur/tokens-css, and the current @digitaltableteur/react package version are published with private package status and org read-write access. Strict publish-ready mode passes --expect-react=unpublished so duplicate React publishes fail until the next package version is prepared.

5.16.note: check:react-registry-install installs the exact private @digitaltableteur/react version from npm into a clean consumer, resolves @digitaltableteur/react/style.css and token CSS from node_modules, SSR-renders representative stable components, compiles a strict TypeScript consumer, and writes .omx/state/design-system/react-registry-install/latest.json. Strict pre-publish verification uses --expect-unpublished for the next React patch version.

5.17.note: Root package.json no longer declares design-system package workspaces. The app/root install now depends on @digitaltableteur/react, @digitaltableteur/tokens, and @digitaltableteur/tokens-css from npm, while local package sources remain under packages/* for build/pack/publish checks. Added check:package-registry-resolution and wired it into the OIDC workflow, Trusted Publisher guard, and React publish preflight; it fails on package-lock workspace links, local packages/* resolution, symlinked node_modules entries, or app/provider imports that locally consume exports already available from @digitaltableteur/react. Remaining app/provider @dt imports must be explicitly classified as non-package app/product/site surfaces.

5.18.note: Added check:storybook-registry-package plus a Registry/Package smoke story. The guard verifies Storybook resolves @digitaltableteur/react, @digitaltableteur/react/style.css, @digitaltableteur/tokens, and @digitaltableteur/tokens-css/tokens.css from registry node_modules paths and rejects Storybook aliases that point @digitaltableteur/* back at local packages/*. check:react-publish-preflight now runs it after storybook:build.
